topics.topic: Whether an omitted confirmation value clears or preserves a valid pending confirmation
questions: When a valid-session, valid-CSRF submission omits the confirmation value while a valid pending confirmation exists, does the pending confirmation remain available or is it cleared?

quotes: take_confirmation: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST refuse with the CONFIRMATION_REFUSED member of = models.RefusalCode at the stage the imported REFUSAL_STAGE_AUTHENTICATION constant names and one failure with an empty path: of the CONFIRMATION_NOT_PENDING member of = models.RefusalKind when the session holds no pending confirmation; of the CONFIRMATION_EXPIRED member of = models.RefusalKind, clearing the pending one whatever value is given, when the monotonic reading is at or past the reading it was shown at plus the imported CONFIRMATION_VALID_MINUTES constant, in nanoseconds of the monotonic reading; of the CONFIRMATION_OTHER_VALUE member of = models.RefusalKind, leaving the pending one as it is, when presented_value is None or not equal to it through equal_in_constant_time.
judgement.why: P1 judged this same question on unchanged passages: omission is presented_value None, so the valid pending confirmation is preserved.
options: Retain the valid pending confirmation when the confirmation value is omitted.
Clear or consume the pending confirmation when the confirmation value is omitted.
Vary the disposition by confirmed action.
consequences: The later contract selects retention, so the owner may resubmit with the already-shown value while it remains valid.
